content.text:
**What I'd tell my friend:** Psagot Trade looks cheap and I'd probably open it, but I'm only kind of sure. What decided it: "דמי חשבון קבועים 0.00 ₪ לחודש", so no monthly account fee. Buying or selling costs "0.07%", minimum "2.00 ₪" a trade, which sounds like nothing. There's also something "0.03% לרבעון", and the part I could read was about holding the stocks and funds there. You need "10,000 ₪" to open, and I have 30. I can buy "קרן סל" and "קרן נאמנות", both marked green "אפשר". "ניירות ערך זרים" is marked "לא ידוע", so I don't know if I can buy the S&P directly. That bugs me, because the S&P is the whole reason I'm doing this.

**How it went:**
- **First screen:** The big title "פסגות ניירות ערך (פסגות טרייד)" is a name I know, so I stayed.
- **"התעריפון":** I stopped on the big numbers: 0.07%, 2.00 ₪, 0.03%, 1.5 אגורות לדולר, then 0.5%, then 0.00 ₪.
  - There are two "המרת מטבע" lines, one "1.5 אגורות לדולר" and one "0.5%". Which one is it? I got stuck there.
- **"מה אפשר לקנות כאן":** Two green "אפשר" and one orange "לא ידוע". Under the orange one there's a grey paragraph I didn't read.
- **Second screen:** Orange "המסמך אומר אחרת" badges keep popping up.
  - The ad says "פטור מלא מדמי ניהול ללא הגבלת זמן", but next to it it says "0.12% … 0.03% גבייה רבעונית".
  - On currency, the ad says no conversion fee ("ללא עמלות המרה"), but the document says "1.5 אגורות עבור כל דולר".
  - So the ad says free and the paperwork doesn't. Not great.
  - Then I saw the big "10,000.00 ₪" minimum and the buttons.
- **What I skipped:** The grey disclaimers, the "מה מגן על הכסף" fold, and "חשבון ניירות ערך · 2" at the bottom. I didn't press either button.

**Words I didn't get:** "דמי משמרת", "מק"מ", "ני"ע", "מרווח ההמרה", "חבר בורסה", "ניירות ערך זרים · לא ידוע". I also don't know how "לרבעון" turns into shekels.

I didn't get bored. I just got lost at the two currency numbers and at "המסמך אומר אחרת".
